desc:
👻 Welcome to Save a Soul! 🪽

Lost Souls are drifting across haunted islands, waiting for someone to bring them home! Rescue them before anyone else does and carry them back to your base! ✨

How to Play:
🕊️ Fly across the islands
👻 Save Souls and bring them back to your base
⚡ Gain +1 Flight Speed as you progress
🌪️ Train in the Wind Tunnel to fly even faster
🔮 Hatch Souls into Spirits to earn Cash
💵 Upgrade your base to hold more Spirits
❄️ Find rare mutations like Slimy and Frozen
🤝 Trade Spirits with other players

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your Cash and fly even farther!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
